questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative form of beautiful?
explanation: Most beautiful is correct. Beautiful is B-E-A-U-T-I-F-U-L. Superlatives use most before long adjectives.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of good?
explanation: Best is correct - B-E-S-T. Best is the superlative form of good. Good better best is the comparison pattern.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of transparent?
explanation: Opaque is correct - O-P-A-Q-U-E. Opaque means not transparent. The QUE ending is often misspelled.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of bad?
explanation: Worst is correct - W-O-R-S-T. Worst is the superlative of bad. Bad worse worst is the pattern.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of optimistic?
explanation: Pessimistic is correct - P-E-S-S-I-M-I-S-T-I-C. Double S. Pessimistic means expecting the worst outcome.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of far?
explanation: Farthest is correct - F-A-R-T-H-E-S-T. Farthest is the superlative of far meaning the greatest distance.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of voluntary?
explanation: Compulsory is correct - C-O-M-P-U-L-S-O-R-Y. Compulsory means required by law or obligation. An antonym of voluntary.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of few?
explanation: Fewest is correct - F-E-W-E-S-T. Fewest is the superlative of few meaning the smallest number.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of complex?
explanation: Simplistic is correct - S-I-M-P-L-I-S-T-I-C. Simplistic means treating a complex issue as if it were simpler than it is. An informal antonym of complex.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of little?
explanation: Least is correct - L-E-A-S-T. Least is the superlative of little meaning smallest in amount.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of lenient?
explanation: Stringent is correct - S-T-R-I-N-G-E-N-T. Stringent means strict or severe. It is an antonym of lenient.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of many?
explanation: Most is correct - M-O-S-T. Most is the superlative of many or much meaning the greatest quantity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of arrogant?
explanation: Humble is correct - H-U-M-B-L-E. Humble means modest and not proud. It is an antonym of arrogant.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of intelligent?
explanation: Most intelligent is correct. Intelligent is I-N-T-E-L-L-I-G-E-N-T. Double L. Superlative uses most for long adjectives.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of generous?
explanation: Miserly is correct - M-I-S-E-R-L-Y. Miserly means extremely reluctant to spend money. An antonym of generous.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of careful?
explanation: Most careful is correct. Careful is C-A-R-E-F-U-L. Superlative of long adjectives uses most before the adjective.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of clarity?
explanation: Obscurity is correct - O-B-S-C-U-R-I-T-Y. Obscurity means being unknown or unclear. An antonym of clarity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of rich?
explanation: Wealthiest is correct - W-E-A-L-T-H-I-E-S-T. Wealthiest is the superlative of wealthy meaning having the most wealth.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of ancient?
explanation: Contemporary is correct - C-O-N-T-E-M-P-O-R-A-R-Y. Contemporary means modern or current. An antonym of ancient.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of tall?
explanation: Tallest is correct - T-A-L-L-E-S-T. Tallest is the superlative of tall. Double L before EST.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of permanent?
explanation: Temporary is correct - T-E-M-P-O-R-A-R-Y. Temporary means lasting only for a limited time. An antonym of permanent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of happy?
explanation: Happiest is correct - H-A-P-P-I-E-S-T. Happy ends in Y so Y changes to I before adding EST. Double P.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of abundant?
explanation: Scarce is correct - S-C-A-R-C-E. Scarce means insufficient in quantity. An antonym of abundant.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of strong?
explanation: Strongest is correct - S-T-R-O-N-G-E-S-T. Strongest is the superlative of strong.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of courageous?
explanation: Cowardly is correct - C-O-W-A-R-D-L-Y. Cowardly means lacking courage. An antonym of courageous.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of narrow?
explanation: Narrowest is correct - N-A-R-R-O-W-E-S-T. Narrowest is the superlative of narrow meaning the smallest width. Double R.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of reluctant?
explanation: Enthusiastic is correct - E-N-T-H-U-S-I-A-S-T-I-C. Enthusiastic means showing keen interest. An antonym of reluctant.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of late?
explanation: Latest is correct - L-A-T-E-S-T. Latest is the superlative of late meaning most recent or most delayed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of flexible?
explanation: Rigid is correct - R-I-G-I-D. Rigid means unable to bend or be forced out of shape. An antonym of flexible.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of difficult?
explanation: Most difficult is correct. Difficult is D-I-F-F-I-C-U-L-T. Double F. Superlative of long adjectives uses most.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of victory?
explanation: Defeat is correct - D-E-F-E-A-T. Defeat means a loss. An antonym of victory.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of wise?
explanation: Wisest is correct - W-I-S-E-S-T. Wisest is the superlative of wise. The E at the end of wise is dropped before EST.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of sincere?
explanation: Hypocritical is correct - H-Y-P-O-C-R-I-T-I-C-A-L. Hypocritical means behaving in a way that contradicts stated beliefs. An antonym of sincere.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of extraordinary?
explanation: Most extraordinary is correct. Extraordinary is E-X-T-R-A-O-R-D-I-N-A-R-Y. Note the correct vowel pattern.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of clarity?
explanation: Vagueness is correct - V-A-G-U-E-N-E-S-S. Vagueness means lack of clarity. An antonym of clarity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of young?
explanation: Youngest is correct - Y-O-U-N-G-E-S-T. Youngest is the superlative of young meaning the least old.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of transparent?
explanation: Opaque is correct - O-P-A-Q-U-E. Opaque means not allowing light to pass through. An antonym of transparent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of lazy?
explanation: Laziest is correct - L-A-Z-I-E-S-T. Lazy ends in Y so Y changes to I before adding EST.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of loyal?
explanation: Treacherous is correct - T-R-E-A-C-H-E-R-O-U-S. Treacherous means guilty of betrayal. An antonym of loyal.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of important?
explanation: Most important is correct. Important is I-M-P-O-R-T-A-N-T. Long adjectives use most for superlative.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of success?
explanation: Failure is correct - F-A-I-L-U-R-E. Failure means lack of success. It is the antonym of success.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of brave?
explanation: Bravest is correct - B-R-A-V-E-S-T. Bravest is the superlative of brave. The E is dropped before adding EST.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of virtuous?
explanation: Corrupt is correct - C-O-R-R-U-P-T. Double R. Corrupt means dishonest and willing to act illegally. An antonym of virtuous.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of popular?
explanation: Most popular is correct. Popular is P-O-P-U-L-A-R. Long adjectives use most for superlative.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of magnificent?
explanation: Mediocre is correct - M-E-D-I-O-C-R-E. Mediocre means of only moderate quality. An antonym of magnificent.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of curious?
explanation: Most curious is correct. Curious is C-U-R-I-O-U-S. Long adjectives use most for superlative.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of rational?
explanation: Irrational is correct - I-R-R-A-T-I-O-N-A-L. Double R after prefix IR. Irrational means not logical or reasonable. An antonym of rational.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of dangerous?
explanation: Most dangerous is correct. Dangerous is D-A-N-G-E-R-O-U-S. Long adjectives use most for superlative.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the opposite of knowledge?
explanation: Ignorance is correct - I-G-N-O-R-A-N-C-E. Ignorance means lack of knowledge. An antonym of knowledge.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of the superlative of ambitious?
explanation: Most ambitious is correct. Ambitious is A-M-B-I-T-I-O-U-S. Long adjectives use most for the superlative form.
